title: Three-times mentions and driving modes
summary: This topic is a loose cluster of repeated 'three' references spanning enjoyable driving, app logging failure, workshop returns, screen usability complaints, and mentions of driving modes, with most fragments too incomplete to assign clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the car as fast, safe, and so enjoyable to drive that the owner used it far more than expected.

negative.summary: The negative review reports the BMW app repeatedly failed to record driving data over the first months of ownership.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments mention repeated workshop visits, extra screen taps, driving modes, limited usage time, and a severe criticism of a system, but the examples are too fragmentary or context-poor to classify reliably.

limitations: The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects joined mainly by the word 'three' rather than a single coherent customer issue.
